description:
[FREE] AGATE: ask whether an agent should be trusted before it spends.

Returns decision = allow | allow_with_limit | deny, plus the tier, the per
transaction USDC ceiling, every check that produced the answer, and a receipt
id a merchant can replay. Sign the canonical intent string with the wallet's
key and pass it as `signature` (EIP-191 personal_sign) to reach a full allow:
AGATE1|<action>|<target>|<amount %.6f>|<expires_at epoch>|<wallet lowercase>
Free, keyless, no gas. Spec: https://x402-agent-pay.com/agate/spec
name: agate_verify_agent
